## House-style constants

```{r house-style}
# PNAS final-size preview: this figure is exported directly at its intended
# 7-inch publication width. Physical dimensions that were defined for the
# previous 2x artwork are therefore expressed at final size here.
FONT_FAMILY    <- "Helvetica"
FONT_SIZE_PT   <- 7
FONT_SIZE_GEOM <- FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt
TAG_SIZE_PT    <- 7.5
# Direct data labels remain slightly smaller than interface text so all 15
# models remain identifiable without covering their shared coordinates.
MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_PT   <- 6.5
MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_GEOM <- MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_PT / .pt
LEGEND_SIZE_PT <- FONT_SIZE_PT
# Standardized final physical stroke hierarchy for coded Figures 3-7.
# ggplot2's linewidth unit is approximately 0.75 mm, not one typographic point.
GG_LINE_UNIT_PT  <- 0.75 * 72.27 / 25.4
pt_to_ggline     <- function(x) x / GG_LINE_UNIT_PT
SECONDARY_LINE_PT <- 0.25
AXIS_LINE_PT      <- 0.50
PRIMARY_LINE_PT   <- 0.75
LINE_SIZE       <- pt_to_ggline(SECONDARY_LINE_PT)
AXIS_LINE_SIZE  <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
TICK_LENGTH_PT <- 2.5
POINT_SIZE     <- 1.6
# ggplot2 point borders use a separate stroke scale; 0.53 renders at about
# 0.75 pt in the Cairo PDF device used below.
POINT_STROKE   <- 0.53
CONNECTOR_SIZE <- pt_to_ggline(SECONDARY_LINE_PT)
THINKING_ROW_FILL <- "#F2F2F2"
FIGURE_WIDTH_IN  <- 7
FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN <- 3.5

ACCURACY_A_LIMITS <- c(0.75, 1.01)
ACCURACY_A_BREAKS <- seq(0.75, 1.00, 0.05)
STABILITY_LIMITS  <- c(0, 0.08)
STABILITY_BREAKS  <- seq(0, 0.08, 0.02)
ACCURACY_B_LIMITS <- c(0.35, 1.05)
ACCURACY_B_BREAKS <- seq(0.40, 1.00, 0.15)

theme_figure3 <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(TICK_LENGTH_PT, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.title = element_text(size = LEGEND_SIZE_PT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = LEGEND_SIZE_PT),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(5, "pt"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(8, "pt"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(1, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT, face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Model-level summary statistics

```{r model-level-summary-statistics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
items_per_task <- df %>%
  filter(accuracy_rate > 0) %>%
  mutate(task_items = round(sum_score / accuracy_rate)) %>%
  distinct(question, task_items)

stability_within <- df %>%
  group_by(model, question) %>%
  summarise(task_sd = sd(accuracy_rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(stability_sd = mean(task_sd), .groups = "drop")

model_summary <- df %>%
  left_join(items_per_task, by = "question") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = sum(sum_score) / sum(task_items),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(stability_within, by = "model") %>%
  left_join(model_info, by = "model") %>%
  arrange(desc(accuracy), stability_sd) %>%
  mutate(mode = factor(mode, levels = c("Standard", "Thinking")))

model_order <- model_summary$display_name
```

## Thinking-mode contrast used in panel b

```{r thinking-mode-contrast, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Reproduce the primary thinking-mode accuracy contrast from the Study 1
# objective-analysis notebook. Keeping the calculation here prevents the
# displayed P value from drifting away from the data or model specification.
thinking_model <- c("claude", "Grok", "deepseek", "gemini", "chatgpt")

thinking_accuracy <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Thinking_Model = factor(Thinking_Model, levels = c("1", "0")),
    software = factor(software),
    question = factor(question),
    model = factor(model)
  ) %>%
  filter(software %in% thinking_model) %>%
  group_by(model, question, Thinking_Model, software) %>%
  summarise(
    Prop_Correct = mean(accuracy_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Prop_Correct_adj = pmin(pmax(Prop_Correct, 1e-5), 1 - 1e-5),
    Logit_Prop = qlogis(Prop_Correct_adj)
  )

thinking_accuracy_model <- lmer(
  Logit_Prop ~ Thinking_Model * question + software + (1 | model),
  data = thinking_accuracy
)

thinking_contrast <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(emmeans(thinking_accuracy_model, ~ Thinking_Model))
)

if (nrow(thinking_contrast) != 1 || !is.finite(thinking_contrast$p.value[1])) {
  stop("Could not recover the unique thinking-versus-standard P value.")
}

thinking_p_label <- sprintf(
  "plain('Thinking vs. standard:')~italic(P)~'='~plain('%s')",
  sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", thinking_contrast$p.value[1]))
)
```

## Task-level data

```{r task-level-data}
task_summary <- df %>%
  left_join(model_info, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    task = case_when(
      question == "Q1" ~ "P-value",
      question == "Q2" ~ "95% CI",
      question == "Q3" ~ "Study comparison"
    ),
    task = factor(task, levels = c("P-value", "95% CI", "Study comparison"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(display_name, provider, mode, task) %>%
  summarise(accuracy = mean(accuracy_rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(display_name = factor(display_name, levels = rev(model_order)))

thinking_rows <- task_summary %>%
  distinct(display_name, mode) %>%
  filter(mode == "Thinking") %>%
  mutate(
    row = as.numeric(display_name),
    ymin = row - 0.40,
    ymax = row + 0.40
  )

top_row <- length(levels(task_summary$display_name))
```

## Panel a: Accuracy and stability

```{r panel-a, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
zero_label_layout <- tribble(
  ~display_name,         ~label_x, ~label_y, ~label_hjust, ~use_leader,
  "Gemini 2.0 Flash",      0.7695,   0.0025,          0,       FALSE,
  "Qwen 2.5",               0.932,    0.005,          1,        TRUE,
  "Gemini 2.5 Pro",         0.932,    0.012,          1,        TRUE,
  "DeepSeek-R1",            0.950,    0.005,          0,        TRUE,
  "DeepSeek-V3",            0.950,    0.012,          0,        TRUE,
  "OpenAI o1",              0.992,    0.009,          1,        TRUE,
  "GPT-4o",                 0.992,    0.017,          1,        TRUE
)

zero_labels <- model_summary %>%
  filter(stability_sd == 0) %>%
  left_join(zero_label_layout, by = "display_name")

manual_variable_label_layout <- tribble(
  ~display_name,                    ~label_x, ~label_y, ~label_hjust,
  "OpenAI o4-mini",                   0.8215,   0.0715,          0,
  "Claude 3.7 Sonnet (Extended)",      0.9410,   0.0665,        0.5,
  "Grok 3",                            0.7790,   0.0195,          0,
  "GPT-4.5",                           0.8530,   0.0390,        0.5,
  "Claude 3.7 Sonnet",                 0.8430,   0.0320,        0.5,
  "OpenAI o3",                         0.8160,   0.0770,          0,
  "Grok 3 Think",                      0.9060,   0.0535,        0.5
)

manual_variable_labels <- model_summary %>%
  inner_join(manual_variable_label_layout, by = "display_name")

o4_mini_high_label <- model_summary %>%
  filter(display_name == "OpenAI o4-mini-high") %>%
  mutate(label_x = 0.801, label_y = stability_sd, label_hjust = 1)

panel_a <- ggplot(
  model_summary,
  aes(x = accuracy, y = stability_sd, colour = provider, shape = mode)
) +
  geom_point(size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE) +
  geom_segment(
    data = zero_labels %>% filter(use_leader),
    aes(x = accuracy, y = stability_sd, xend = label_x, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = zero_labels,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = short_name, hjust = label_hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = o4_mini_high_label,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = short_name, hjust = label_hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = manual_variable_labels,
    aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = short_name, hjust = label_hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = MODEL_LABEL_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = provider_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Standard" = 1, "Thinking" = 17)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = ACCURACY_A_LIMITS,
    breaks = ACCURACY_A_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.03))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = STABILITY_LIMITS,
    breaks = STABILITY_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.09, 0.04))
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = "Accuracy",
    y = "Mean within-task SD",
    colour = "Provider",
    shape = "Mode"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  theme_figure3() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5, -6, 4, 5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(20, "pt")
  )

```

## Panel b: Task-level accuracy

```{r panel-b, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
panel_b <- ggplot(
  task_summary,
  aes(x = accuracy, y = display_name, shape = task, fill = task)
) +
  geom_rect(
    data = thinking_rows,
    aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = THINKING_ROW_FILL,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = display_name),
    colour = "grey72",
    linewidth = CONNECTOR_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.375,
    y = top_row - 1,
    label = "Shaded rows indicate thinking mode",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = mean(ACCURACY_B_LIMITS),
    y = top_row + 0.24,
    label = thinking_p_label,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 0.5,
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("P-value" = 24, "95% CI" = 22, "Study comparison" = 21)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "P-value" = "white",
      "95% CI" = "grey80",
      "Study comparison" = "white"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = ACCURACY_B_LIMITS,
    breaks = ACCURACY_B_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
  labs(x = "Accuracy", y = NULL, shape = "Task", fill = "Task") +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 3,
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      override.aes = list(fill = c("white", "grey80", "white"))
    ),
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_figure3() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 4, -6),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

```

## Combine and export

```{r combine-and-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
combined_figure <- panel_a + panel_b +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      size = TAG_SIZE_PT,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0
    ),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.005, 0.98)
  )

combined_figure

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_1.pdf",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = FONT_FAMILY,
  symbolfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_1.png",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_1.svg",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  bg = "white"
)
```
